claudeStubRules.match: You write release notes for a desktop Git client

steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ branch: s.status && s.status.branch.name }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.openReleaseNotes(); const find = (t) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog button')).find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === t); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const btn = find('Generate'); if (btn && !btn.disabled) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } find('Generate').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const p = s.ai['<release notes>']; if (p && (p.phase === 'done' || p.phase === 'error')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const ta = document.querySelector('.dialog-body textarea'); const dialog = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: dialog && dialog.kind, markdown: ta ? ta.value : null }); })()

(async () => { const find = (t) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.dialog button')).find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === t); find('Insert into CHANGELOG.md').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: s.dialog && s.dialog.kind, files: (s.status ? s.status.files.map((f) => f.path) : []), selected: s.changes.selectedPaths }); })()
